name: chunking-primer
title: A primer on chunking
blurb: Six pages of notes on chunking, written for this playground.
shows: Headings, a running footer and a repeated paragraph, so every step has something to show. Two questions are planted to miss: one answer is a sentence longer than a piece, and one question uses words the document never does.

teaches.question: size-factors
teaches.why: The answer is one sentence of more than 400 characters, longer than a default piece, so no piece holds it whole.
teaches.fix_text: In Chunk, make the pieces 800 characters, or split By sentence.

teaches.question: kept-whole
teaches.why: The question says set, item and kept whole where the document says collection, entry and one per piece, so the search ranks the answer far below the 5 checked.
teaches.fix_text: In the search settings, rewrite the question with PRF, which borrows the document's own words.
